name: What is the typical step-by-step process of a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical step-by-step process of a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathroom renovation follows a distinct sequential order to protect finished surfaces and ensure proper waterproofing. Work begins with complete demolition and removal of old fixtures. Next comes rough-in framing, plumbing, and electrical updates. Once rough inspections pass, contractors install moisture-resistant backer board and waterproofing membranes. Tile installation, grout, and wall paint follow. The final phase involves setting the vanity, installing plumbing fixtures, mounting lighting, and sealing all transitions with silicone.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process goes from demolition to rough plumbing and electrical, followed by waterproofing, tile setting, paint, and final installation of vanities and fixtures.
